## Houston v0.6.6

- Connecting a Claude subscription now works right in your browser with an approval code, including on the web and older computers.
- Deleting an eligible team space now switches you away immediately and shows clear progress.
- Browsing community skills now handles unavailable listings more cleanly.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
